sql:
SELECT toYear(first_date) AS CohortYear, count(*) AS CustomerCount, avg(lifetime_value) AS AvgCustomerLifetimeValue
FROM (
  SELECT CustomerKey, MIN(DateKey) AS first_date, SUM(SalesAmount) AS lifetime_value
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  GROUP BY CustomerKey
)
GROUP BY CohortYear
ORDER BY CohortYear
